newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi wants to phase out foreign limo chauffeurs.
newsitem.headline: Saudi wants to phase out foreign limo chauffeurs.

text.p: Saudi Arabia wants to phase out all foreign limousine drivers to help find more jobs for nationals, a Saudi newspaper said on Sunday.
But limousine services say hiring Saudis is expensive and the "Saudization" process could take time, the English-language Arab News said.
"Many limousine companies find Saudization a costly proposition," the paper said. "They say hiring a Saudi driver is a costly affair and it increases their overheads."
Of the 18 million people living in Saudi Arabia, about six million are expatriates. Saudis make up less than seven percent of private sector employees.
Saudi citizens had for decades favoured well-paid, half-day managerial jobs in the state sector. But the government can no longer create more public sector jobs to employ them.
